verdict.rationale: Washington ESD is a state agency offering unemployment tax, benefits, and paid-leave services through web portals (eServices, EAMS, SAW). It is not an AI agent or AI host that could act as an MCP client, so plugging MCP servers into it is a category error. Nothing in the evidence shows an AI assistant or tool-calling feature that would make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
